notes: Version 2.2 corrects what the paper attributes to BornInfeld. BornInfeld supplies a motivation for non-injectivity and the capacity axiom [A-cap]; it neither derives nor selects a Born-Infeld action, and it leaves open which continuum quantity inherits the capacity bound. The Born-Infeld-type action of the gradient of chi studied here is the paper's own adopted model, and the claim that it saturates the constitutive relation is withdrawn. The contraction of the gradient is written with one index. The parity lemma, the parity covariance of the response family and the fixed-probe countermodel are unchanged.
